plain_description.what: The leaves and shape of one existing anchored tree are kept fixed, but each leaf's centre is recomputed using only training questions of the leaf's declared class. It then checks whether this 'class-pure' version files held-out questions better than the tree as built.
plain_description.why: It tests whether the purity of the questions used to fit each leaf is the lever behind k-means' filing advantage over the tree.
plain_description.information: A gain says purer fit sets improve filing. No gain would say the k-means advantage comes from something else. Result: done. The class-pure refit filed held-out questions 2.6 points better (95% interval +1.9 to +3.2), above the noise bar. It uses more training labels than the original tree, almost all of the gain is on MMLU-Pro, and it says nothing about anchor-free or label-free trees. Whether the gain tracks impurity is undetermined.
